**MuRIL is fine-tuned on Bishnupriya FiNE-MiBBiC dataset for Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition. FiNE-MiBBiC is an extension of [SampurNER](https://huggingface.co/datasets/prachuryyaIITG/SampurNER) dataset which is created using the [EaMaTa](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40405) framework, utilizing the [Few-NERD](https://huggingface.co/datasets/DFKI-SLT/few-nerd) dataset.**
Read the paper: [SampurNER in AAAI-2026](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40405) SampurNER Dataset: [datasets/prachuryyaIITG/SampurNER](https://huggingface.co/datasets/prachuryyaIITG/SampurNER) The tagset of [Few-NERD](https://aclanthology.org/2021.acl-long.248.pdf) is a fine-grained tagset. Recall: 64.13
**F1: 62.97**
## Training Parameters: Epochs: 6
Optimizer: AdamW
Learning Rate: 5e-5
Weight Decay: 0.01
Batch Size: 64
